pages.title: Acme Analytics — privacy-friendly analytics for SaaS founders
pages.text:
Know which pages bring signups, without cookie banners.
Privacy-friendly analytics for SaaS founders.
Founders waste hours in bloated dashboards that track everything but answer nothing.
Acme shows the five numbers that matter in one weekly email.
No cookies. No consent banner. No personal data stored.

pages.title: Pricing — Acme Analytics
pages.text:
Simple pricing
Start with a free 14-day trial. No credit card required.
Starter is $9 per month for up to 100k pageviews.
Growth is $29 per month for up to 1M pageviews.
Acme is GDPR compliant and hosted in the EU.

pages.title: Features — Acme Analytics
pages.text:
Features
Setup takes two minutes with one script tag.
The script weighs under 1 KB.
Integrates with Stripe to show revenue per traffic source.
Import your Google Search Console queries.
